articles.headline: Vandy's Mia Woolfolk details how she shook off fouls, hit the glass
articles.description: Two first-half fouls forced Woolfolk to reset, and she explains how knowing her teammates had her back helped her lock in and attack the glass after halftime for the No. 8 Commodores.
